titulo: Why Can't You Remember Being a Baby?
descripcion:
You were alive for about three years that you have zero memory of. You learned to walk, to talk, to recognise your own name. And it's all gone.

This is infantile amnesia — and the reason for it is stranger than "babies just can't form memories". They can. Your brain recorded those years and then recorded straight over them.
